text: International Economics and Trade (abbreviated as "IE&T") is an interdisciplinary subject that focuses on cross-border economic activities. It integrates economics, management, law, and foreign language skills, and studies commodity trade, service exchanges, capital flows, and related policy regulations among countries. From customs declaration of imported and exported goods to cross-border e-commerce operations, from international investment decisions to global trade negotiations, this major connects the markets and resources of different countries and is a "economic bridge" discipline in the era of globalization.
